title: Exclude fixed-clock Type B same-mask idle squares (0% κ change)
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`, all nine equal-role, equal-singleton Type B even-idle pairs fail replacement by their square at either original clock. The exact independently reproduced complete comparison is #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, κ = 0.00364665195644.

Both exact projector replays exhaust all nine pairs. No retained interval contains its repeated stage variable. Its nonzero off-axis coefficient therefore persists at that stage’s physical −1 eigenvalue, with every other body and q at +1. At clocks 4646 and 4660, the old-minus-square entry is −2/3. The nine stages are distinct, so this also excludes every nonempty fixed-clock subset. Zero unresolved cases.

The price-only one-edit upper is 63.516523445741434 raw for a single rank-eight square or 127.03304689148287 for an ordinary square. The nine-edit relaxation is 571.6487110116728 or 1143.2974220233457 raw before ancillary costs. The compatible saving in the tested scope is zero.

## Task and verification

Changed scope of `joint-query-controller`, revision 8, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The repeated masks differ from the disjoint masks in #7315 and #7357. Use CPython 3.12 from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-b-same-mask-square-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-type-b-same-mask-square-bound
```

The replay rebuilds the complete price, both exact projector proofs and the physical character receipt, and rejects changed price and caller inputs. Local registered, committed source and mode, navigation and official Git-free checks passed. The branch carries the existing #7257 onboarding repair. No candidate reached the complete supplier gate.

## Credit and open question

#7357 supplies the idle stock and interval method, #7315 the projector precedent, #7295/#7296 the grouping and physical sign context, #7113 the caller, #7334 the comparison, and #7298 the tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. A changed interval or multi-role provider needs a complete new price and exact physical binding.
